parts.title: Planting Day
parts.text: Leo, Priya, and Ben went to the backyard garden. The ground was **damp** from the rain. Ben wore his **shiny** red boots. Priya used a spade to **scoop** out little holes. Leo dropped one **tiny** seed into each hole.

parts.title: Water and Wait
parts.text: They covered the seeds with dirt. Ben gave them a **sprinkle** of water. Soon the dirt was dark and **soggy**. A fat worm began to **crawl** across his boot, and Priya giggled. Then they went inside to wait.

parts.title: A Surprise
parts.text: Two weeks later, a **fuzzy** green leaf popped up. Next to it, a yellow flower began to **bloom**. A bee came to **buzz** around it. “Ben, **hurry**!” called Leo. “Come and **pluck** a ripe strawberry from the old patch!”

parts.title: Sweet Treats
parts.text: The friends shared the strawberries on the porch. Their garden was small, but they felt proud. They could not wait to plant more seeds.
